title: Per-tenant soft-eviction-windows and adaptive throughput accountant
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Tenants with bursty traffic were seeing premature evictions during transient spikes because autoscaler cooldowns and eviction heuristics were uniform. This change introduces a per-tenant soft-eviction window that decays with observed burst tail latency and an adaptive throughput accountant that tracks committed vs observed throughput to make eviction decisions more tolerant of short surges. The PR contains: design and rationale, implementation, telemetry, and migration guidance. Key points: 1) soft-eviction-window: per-tenant parameter persisted in the reservation ledger with safe defaults and policy-driven overrides; windows are smoothed using an EWMA of recent burst durations. 2) throughput-accountant: a sliding-window counter that exposes committed_tokens, observed_tokens, burst_headroom and a degradation_score used by the admission controller. 3) eviction policy integration: admission controller consults throughput-accountant and soft-eviction-window before marking slots for preemption; we bias toward preemption of ephemeral warmlets when degradation_score is low. 4) Telemetry: added metrics tenant_soft_eviction_window_seconds, tenant_throughput_committed, tenant_throughput_observed, tenant_degradation_score, eviction_considered_count, eviction_preempted_count, and a per-tenant histogram for preemption_latency. 5) Controls: new API knobs on Dedicated config to override default window and accountant sensitivity, documented in console and terraform provider. 6) Backwards compatibility: new fields are optional; behavior defaults to current autoscaler. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked ENG-2043, - [x] Implementation with unit and integration tests, - [x] End-to-end canary on staging clusters, - [x] Telemetry dashboard template and alerts, - [x] Migration notes and rollback plan. Follow-ups: tune EWMA alpha across regions, expose a Lite-mode for low-cardinality tenants. See commits and changed files for specifics.
commits: feat(autoscaler): introduce TenantThroughputAccountant and soft eviction window storage
fix(test): stabilize ledger-backed window test with deterministic clock
chore(doc): add dedicated config knobs and terraform notes
perf(kv): batch update eviction metrics to reduce KV churn
review_comments: Arjun: Can you explain how the EWMA alpha was chosen and whether it should be tenant-configurable? Maya: Chose alpha=0.25 based on 48h sampling of staging traces; added Dedicated knob to override per-tenant; will expose in follow-up tuning RFC.

Rosa: The metric tenant_degradation_score seems correlated with CPU saturations in some clusters, should we normalize by node capacity? Maya: Good catch, added a normalization factor and a comment in accountant.go; left a TODO to surface node-level capacity in the console.
Liam: Integration tests flaked twice on arm64 CI due to timing assumptions in preemption latency test, please make clock deterministic. Maya: Switched to fake clock and added retries; CI now green.

QA: How do we rollback if customer sees increased latency after enabling? Maya: Rollback plan added to docs: flip knob in Dedicated config, reapply previous reservation snapshot; warmlet prewarming logic is safe to revert without eviction storm.
release_notes: Added per-tenant soft eviction windows and an adaptive throughput accountant to make eviction decisions more tolerant of short bursts. New telemetry and config knobs for Dedicated deployments. No breaking changes.
